title: Film Brazil — retro infographic explainer with a Brazil mascot
substyle: Retro flat infographic (proposed): kinetic numbers and letters + rubber-hose mascot

secondary_motion: letters hop in arcs and settle, scattered letters assemble, sparkles and ribbon waves on holds, a dancing mascot; overshoot visible on sheets but not measured
color: saturated retro 5-color palette (mustard, teal, burnt orange, navy, cream) used throughout; one or two colors dominate per scene
typography: type is the main cast: giant numerals with ordinals, mixed retro faces (slab, script, stencil), letters fly, bounce and assemble, words become wipes
shape_language: precise flat geometry (circles, diamonds, bars) softened by paper grain and a rubber-hose mascot
character_humor: Brazil-shaped mascot with sunglasses walks, dances and plays scale gags (giant shoe) at start, middle and end; most of the film is data

signature: A Brazil-shaped rubber-hose mascot bookends a fast parade of retro kinetic statistics in which every number, letter or coin grows into the wipe that opens the next fact.

music.summary: No usable beat (129 BPM detected but pulse clarity 0.14, percussive share 0.37); cuts on beat 20% vs 30% chance and median shot ~5 beats, so pacing follows the phrase/fact structure (likely narration-led), not the music.

family_note: Placed in 03 Character because a mascot carries the opening, a mid section and the ending and the tone is expressive (7.5) at mid energy (3.8), inside the Character zone. Doubt: ~70% of screen time is kinetic infographic typography, closer to a missing 'kinetic infographic explainer' sub-style (could also sit under 02 Playful reel at lower energy). Retro paper grain hints at 04 but there is no collage or footage.

behaviors.mechanism: opening push-in from space onto a rotating globe, accelerating into Brazil, which becomes the mascot's flat stage
behaviors.notes: Measured on sqrt-area of the yellow Brazil shape f142-270 (rmse 0.016). Confounded by globe rotation (Brazil turns toward camera), so approximate. Pure ease-in with no landing: it hands off into a cut-free scene change at f270. Frame values repeat every 5th frame: 24 fps animation in a 29.97 container.

behaviors.mechanism: letters of a word ('population') arrive scattered and rotated below the headline and drift into their slots
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet b (f545-577). Each infographic statement is built from a big numeral with an ordinal + a headline word + a small secondary word that assembles letter by letter.

behaviors.mechanism: letters hop in one by one along an arc (like a ball bounce) and settle into the word ('economy')
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet b (f681-697); stagger approximate. Same family of per-letter builds: coins drop and stack onto '16 BILLION' (f971-1013), digits of '16.000' roll on beside a clapperboard (f3035-3075).

behaviors.mechanism: a word is written on in script, then repeated above in caps whose letters pop in from both ends inward, then a third stylised version builds: one word stacked in three typefaces
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet d: script write-on f1966-2001 (~35 f), caps converge f2029-2057 (~28 f), third line f2071-2092. Typeface stacking as emphasis is a signature of this video.

behaviors.mechanism: a graphic from the current fact grows or morphs into the next scene: rings spin off the '5' and open the yellow '8' scene, a coin expands into the network diagram, the 'O' of 'shoot' becomes a camera lens whose aperture opens to the next scene, a clapperboard stripe sweeps diagonally
behaviors.notes: Durations 8-20 f read from sheets b, c, d, e (f593-617, f1041-1048, f1945-1966, f3019-3035). Many 'cuts' in metrics are these fast graphic wipes.

behaviors.mechanism: circular icons pop in around a central $ coin one after another and dotted connector lines draw between them
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet c (f1048-1083); stagger approximate. The network then collapses back into the coin, which becomes the next transition (f1146-1167).

behaviors.mechanism: rubber-hose Brazil mascot walks in place while ground dashes scroll (speed lines), later dances in a loop beside a tiny film crew as the closing hold
behaviors.notes: Walk f288-350 (sheet a); dance loop f5011-5335 (sheet f). Bookend: the mascot opens and closes the story; scale gag with a giant shoe at f437-513.

behaviors.mechanism: on white, the flag mark tilts in while the FILMBRAZIL wordmark letters assemble left to right; partner logos (apro, ApexBrasil) pop in after
behaviors.notes: Read from sheet f (f5371-5389), then ~6 s still hold. Transition into it: cream panels slide away to white (f5353).

behaviors.mechanism: scene changes and text builds follow the sequence of facts, not the music: no clear pulse and cuts land on beat less often than chance
